capabilities: Play local audio files (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, FLAC, AAC) in a sidebar view
Manage a music library with playlists, favorites, artists, albums, and search
Display standard and word-by-word lyrics synced to playback from embedded metadata
Control playback modes (sequential, loop, shuffle), speed, volume, and queue
Watch the music folder for file changes and rebuild the index when needed
disambiguation: Plays music only; it does not record audio like the core Audio recorder, and it reads lyrics only from embedded tags, not .lrc files or online sources.
extras: Recommends installing beta builds via BRAT; notes that a dedicated music folder is advised for large vaults since an empty folder setting scans the whole vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play and organize local music files stored in the vault; the core audio feature only records.
summary: Sidebar music player that plays local audio files from the vault with library management, playlists, favorites, synced lyrics, and playback mode controls.
